story.iWant: to scaffold the Auth microservice and connect it to PostgreSQL
story.soThat: we have a secure foundation for minting JWTs and verifying User Identity across the microservice ecosystem
story.tasks: - Scaffold NestJS base project via NestJS CLI inside `services/auth-service` - Initialize PostgreSQL connection (TypeORM/Prisma) - Provide `/health` status endpoint - Implement Swagger UI plugin for OpenAPI generation - Achieve 95% code coverage with Jest unit tests

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: App starts dynamically leveraging the `AUTH_APP_PORT` env variable.
Connects to `auth_db` cleanly without throwing uncaught promises.
Swagger is visible at `/api/docs` exposing valid OpenAPI endpoints.
Jest Test coverage exceeds 95% logic paths.

tests.standards: NestJS Jest testing framework natively provided.

ideas.idea: e2e test: Start container, curl port, verify response.
unit test: Ensure postgres initialization module returns valid Provider.
Command constraint: Enforce execution of `npm run test:cov` inside the auth folder to ensure minimums meet 95%.
